description: A valid token issued for website A is sent with an unknown website B. Upstream skips the website lookup whenever the token has any websiteId.

expected_upstream.notes: Upstream stores an event and a session for a website that does not exist.

expected_holocron.notes: Tokens are bound to their website. A token for another website is ignored as if absent, so the normal lookup refuses the unknown website with "Website not found." (docs/decisions/0005, cache tokens bound to their website).

validation_reason: Replayed against official Umami 3.4.0 by tools/collection-harness/replay.mjs. Result in docs/evidence/m01-collection-validation.md.
